description: This Rust source file implements a component-based rendering system for transforming SQL query results into various HTTP response formats such as HTML, JSON, and CSV. It defines classes and functions for handling different response components, rendering templates, managing HTTP headers, cookies, and error handling, and supports embedded and page shell components.

classes.name: PageContext
classes.description: Enum representing the current state of the page rendering process, including header, body, and close states.

classes.name: HeaderContext
classes.description: Handles initial HTTP response setup, processing header components, and transitioning to body or close states.

classes.name: AnyRenderBodyContext
classes.description: Enum to dispatch rendering calls to specific renderer implementations for HTML, JSON, or CSV formats.

classes.name: JsonBodyRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for JSON responses, supporting array, JSON Lines, and server-sent events formats.

classes.name: CsvBodyRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for CSV responses, managing CSV formatting and writing.

classes.name: HtmlRenderContext
classes.description: Renderer for HTML responses, managing template rendering, components, and page shell.

classes.name: SplitTemplateRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of individual template components, managing local variables, and rendering lifecycle.

classes.name: HeaderComponent
classes.description: Enumeration of header components such as status code, headers, redirect, json, csv, cookie, authentication, download, and log.
